introduction: Most Conspiracy Theories are stupid. By the power of the internet they spread like wildfire and ofte
lead_intro: Are you curious about a foolproof system to debunk conspiracy theories? Watch this video to learn a simple yet effective approach!

quiz.question: According to the system presented in the video, what is the first question to ask when evaluating a conspiracy theory?
choices: Does the theory affect really rich and powerful people?
Is the theory widely accepted by the public?
Is the theory based on scientific evidence?
quiz.answer: Does the theory affect really rich and powerful people?
quiz.explanation: The first question to ask is whether the theory affects really rich and powerful people, as if it does, it is most likely not true.

quiz.question: Applying the system, why is the idea of an easy cure for cancer being suppressed considered unlikely?
choices: Rich people do not get affected by cancer
Former CEO of Apple did not die of cancer
quiz.answer: Former CEO of Apple did not die of cancer
quiz.explanation: Since rich people like the former CEO of Apple can succumb to cancer, the theory of a suppressed cure is debunked.

quiz.question: How does the system disprove the existence of chemtrails conspiracy theory?
choices: Rich people do not breathe air
Obama and Putin do not breathe air
Chemtrails are proven by scientific research
quiz.answer: Obama and Putin do not breathe air
quiz.explanation: By noting that even powerful figures like Obama and Putin breathe air, the chemtrails conspiracy theory is refuted.

quiz.question: Why does the system reject apocalyptic conspiracy theories?
choices: Rich and powerful people actively prepare for the apocalypse
Rich and powerful people do not ignore imminent apocalypses
quiz.answer: Rich and powerful people do not ignore imminent apocalypses
quiz.explanation: Since the rich and powerful do not ignore impending apocalypses, the system asserts that the world will not end soon.

quiz.question: What is the main takeaway of the system to debunk conspiracy theories?
choices: It works for every conspiracy theory out there
It works for some of the most stupid ones
quiz.answer: It works for some of the most stupid ones
quiz.explanation: While the system may not work for every conspiracy theory, it is effective in debunking some of the most absurd ones.
